headline: Executive session on union negotiations and litigation, plus FY'27 school budget and curriculum items.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to discuss collective bargaining with several unions and litigation involving the Waltham Educators Association/MTA. The regular meeting covers the FY'27 School Department Operating Budget, curriculum adoption, the Valor High School Handbook, and other ongoing school topics.

 Waltham, Massachusetts

 1.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the WSSA and/or to

 Technicians and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham School MIS Technicians

 Department Food Service Workers
